title: Should You Buy Now, Pay Later?
summary: Ramsey Show segment answers a listener's question by warning that BNPL marketing increases spending and should be avoided in favor of paying cash.

assertions.quote: you'll spend 45 percent more if you use a buy now pay later service on your website
it's even worse than layaway because you get it now

verdicts.note: Widely agreed historical comparison; the key structural difference (possession before full payment) is accurate.

verdicts.note: Providers describe declines as consumer protection, but the underlying incentive (avoiding losses on bad loans) also serves the lender's own interest.

assertions.quote: stay away from buy now pay later services only pay for it if you can afford it in cash with a debit card
